resources.string: While a video is playing, scrolling down the video page turns it into a small floating player with a close button. Does nothing while paused. Off by default
Go to picture-in-picture when you leave the app from a playing video page (picture-in-picture permission needed). Off by default
Pinch the video to zoom in fullscreen. The zoom is not remembered. Off by default
The picture-in-picture permission was removed in system settings, so auto picture-in-picture has been disabled. Grant the permission again, then re-enable it in the player settings.
Picture-in-picture permission is needed. Allow it in the settings page that just opened, then turn this option on again.
